answer: Picture identity as basalt: each agent must sink a refundable bond to exist, and that stake hardens slowly into standing. To run a sybil swarm you buy one bond per fake, so cost scales linearly with identities, not influence. Misbehave and attestors slash the bond, so the violet flash of a quick fraud never pays. Honest agents draw the nectar of bonds returned plus fees, while an attacker just funds thousands of forfeits the network keeps.
